name: whole_body_single_leg_lift_v2
description: Whole-body one-leg-at-a-time foot lift, v2: same lift motion as whole_body_single_leg_lift_v1 but entered and exited by trajectory instead of by a glide to a loaded pose. v1 died before tick 1 on the runner's post-glide start-pose gate (GLIDE_TOL_DEG 3 deg) because its home_deg was the LOADED champion stand pose, which the servos cannot reach open-loop under body weight on the ground. v2 starts at safe_zero/bench zero and stands itself up: the single 25 Hz absolute trajectory is champion_stand_ground_v1's stand-up ramp (rl_stand_20260812_145534.csv ticks 0..374 at 25 Hz, 375 rows, 15 s) + v1's unchanged 48 s lift sequence (1200 rows) + the same ramp time-reversed as a sit-down lead-out (375 rows, 15 s); 1950 ticks, 78 s total. The seams are exact: the ramp's last row IS the champion stand pose that the lift sequence starts and ends on, so the two duplicated rows are 40 ms holds and there is no discontinuity and no mid-protocol pose gate (one segment). Lift sequence unchanged from v1: 3 s settle at the six-foot stand, then for each leg L0,L1,L2,L3,L4,L5 in order: 1.5 s ramp lifting that foot 20 mm, 2 s hold clear, 1.5 s lower back down the same path, 2 s dwell at the full six-foot stand; 3 s stand lead-out. ONLY ONE FOOT IS EVER OFF THE GROUND: the other five legs hold the stand pose exactly. The 20 mm is a VERTICAL foot displacement at constant radial reach solved with the repo's two-link IK (safe_zero.ik_hip_knee), moving hip ~-13.6..-14.3 deg and knee ~+1.7..+2.1 deg per leg with yaw fixed; radial drift <0.01 mm. Purpose: the first measurement of a SWING-phase load transfer -- tilt excursion and per-servo current cost of taking one foot off the ground under body weight. Soft torque 700; loaded current budget 2.0 A tripping after three consecutive readings above it; hard ceiling 3.0 A. Robot ON THE GROUND (unsupported), operator watching, hands ready; requires force=true.
